notes.title: Meet us at Gamescom 2025
notes.content:
[h2]🎉 Medieval Frontiers is Heading to Gamescom![/h2][p]We’re thrilled to announce that [b]Medieval Frontiers[/b] will be making its public debut at [b]Gamescom[/b] this year! 🏰✨[/p][p]If you’re attending, you’ll have the chance to [b]play an exclusive build of the game[/b], meet members of the dev team, and get a closer look at life on the frontier before our next big public playtest.[/p][h3]📍 Where to Find Us[/h3][p][b]Gamescom 2025 – Home of Indies - Halle 10.2[/b]
From [b]20. - 24. August [/b][/p][h3]🛠️ What You’ll See at Gamescom[/h3][list][*][p]Hands-on gameplay demo[/p][/*][*][p]Sneak peek at new features since the last playtest[/p][/*][*][p]Updated visuals, systems, and AI behavior[/p][/*][*][p]A few surprises we can’t reveal just yet 😉[/p][/*][/list][p]We’ll also be sharing photos, updates, and behind-the-scenes moments from the show floor, so even if you can’t make it to Gamescom, you can still follow along right here on Steam and on our socials.[/p][hr][/hr][p]If you’re at the event, drop by and say hello — we’d love to meet you in person![/p][p][b]– Active Fungus Studios[/b][/p]
